description: Election Commission - Mr. W. H. L. Varna Kumara was declared elected as a Member of Parliament
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy caused by a resignation and the subsequent declaration of a new Member of Parliament for a specific electoral district. The content directly relates to electoral processes, specifically the procedure for filling a vacancy in parliament as outlined in the Constitution and the Parliamentary Elections Act. This falls under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes "Election results and declarations" and matters related to the electoral process and membership of elected bodies.
